display.purpose: Landing hero headlines only; keep tracking at or above -0.04em.

headline.purpose: Page titles, section headings, and dashboard headers.

title.purpose: Card titles, labels with emphasis, pricing plan names, and component headings.

body.purpose: Explanatory copy, queue descriptions, dashboard prose, and FAQ answers.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, nav links, helper labels, and status text.

card-hover.purpose: Clickable repeated cards and pricing panels.

motion.reducedMotion: Global prefers-reduced-motion rule neutralizes CSS transitions and animations.

do: Keep the confirmation step visible whenever an application could be submitted.
Use brand green for primary action, selected state, positive progress, and confirmation.
Use clear status text with color and icons.
dont: Do not make JobPosted look like a mass auto-apply spam tool or hidden autonomous agent.
Do not imply LinkedIn, Workday, or login-gated platforms run from JobPosted servers.
Do not use dark neon AI-console styling, purple/blue gradient SaaS gloss, glassmorphism, or gradient text.
